paragraphs: R' Yehudah bar Niron. See the entry R' Yehudah ben Nirin.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has bar Niron (נירון), while the target has ben Nirin (נירין). Earlier machine OCR had גירון/גירין; those gimel readings are not verified printed alternatives. The relationship between the two supplied forms remains unresolved, and both abbreviated titles remain R'.
